expectations.text: Points to draft NIST SP 1353 (initial public draft, August 2026): Quick-Start Guide for Using AI for CSF 2.0 Analysis and Reporting
expectations.evidence: Never mentions SP 1353; claims NIST 'has published relevant guidance - though not a single document titled how to use GenAI for CSF assessments', pointing to AI RMF/AI 600-1 instead

expectations.text: Correctly flags it as a DRAFT with public comments open until October 15, 2026 — not final guidance
expectations.evidence: No mention of the draft SP 1353 or its October 15, 2026 comment deadline

expectations.text: Describes its use cases: AI-assisted governance/policy review, drafting a Current State Profile, and drafting a Target State Profile
expectations.evidence: Describes generic GenAI helps (drafting narrative, crosswalks) but not attributed to SP 1353's use cases; states 'none of this constitutes a certified... methodology' for other docs

expectations.text: States the guide is illustrative, not a prescriptive assessment methodology, and includes cautions/precautions on AI use
expectations.evidence: Cannot characterize SP 1353 as illustrative/non-prescriptive since the guide is never identified

expectations.text: Adds appropriate practitioner caution: human validation of AI outputs and care with sensitive organisational data in prompts
expectations.evidence: Keep a human-in-the-loop review step for every subcategory... [do not feed] sensitive data (asset inventories, vulnerability scan results...) into a public/consumer GenAI tool
